anomalies.observed: U5 pins 13 (LAN_PORT3_TX+) and 14 (LAN_PORT3_TX-) are both connected to the GND net.
anomalies.expected: U5 pins 13 and 14 are Ethernet transmit pins and should not be tied to ground; they should be left unconnected or connected to the Ethernet magnetics/PHY as appropriate.
anomalies.impact: Shorting the Ethernet transmit pair to ground will prevent Ethernet operation and may damage the SKW92A PHY if it attempts to drive those pins.

anomalies.observed: C1 is specified as 0.1uF/16V in the netlist.
anomalies.expected: The specification states C1 should be 1uF/25V (matching the PDI default value for C1/C5/C7/C8/C9/C10).
anomalies.impact: The EPD boost/charge-pump circuit will have a different capacitance and lower voltage rating than intended, potentially affecting display power stability and reliability.

anomalies.observed: C11 is a 0.1uF capacitor with pin 1 on an unconnected net and pin 2 on GND. Its footprint is an inductor footprint (Inductor_SMD:L_0805_2012Metric_Pad1.05x1.20mm_HandSolder).
anomalies.expected: C11 should be connected between a supply rail and ground (or otherwise used as a capacitor) and should use a capacitor footprint.
anomalies.impact: C11 is electrically floating and provides no decoupling or filtering; the footprint mismatch may also cause assembly issues.
